title: Corte Suprema de Justicia - Portal Oficial
description: Led the modernization of the Supreme Court of Colombia's official web portal. Architected and deployed a high-performance CMS that improved overall site load performance by 40% and delivers critical judicial transparency to millions of citizens.

title: Supremo Buscador - Jurisprudential Search Engine
description: Designed and built an ultra-fast judicial search engine enabling instant public access to over 500,000 legal rulings and court precedents. Drastically optimized query throughput and indexing mechanisms.
highlights: Reduced search time from minutes to milliseconds

title: ESAV - Judicial Digital Ecosystem
description: Comprehensive digital platform transforming traditional paper-based judicial workflows into secure digital cases. Facilitates end-to-end case tracking, evidence management, and magistrate workflows.
highlights: Reduced case processing cycle from 4 months to 10 days

title: Lumina Red Lab - AI Innovation
description: Built during the 'Building Our Future in AI' Hackathon — an interactive AI-powered application translating community datasets into actionable insights and intuitive conversational experiences.

title: Davivienda - Real Estate Financial Platform
description: Engineered secure backend services and API gateways for one of Colombia's largest financial institutions, automating mortgage pre-approvals, financial history validation, and real-time risk scoring.

title: Troop Platform
description: Collaborative enterprise platform connecting teams with dynamic task orchestration. Built responsive, accessible user interfaces and streamlined API integration layers.

title: TuAp.com Mobile & Web E-Commerce
description: Cross-platform mobile and web e-commerce marketplace built for local businesses with real-time order tracking, catalog management, and payment integration.

title: Movie Searcher TMDB
description: Dynamic web application integrating The Movie Database (TMDB) API to provide instant debounced movie searches, high-resolution media galleries, ratings, and recommendations.

title: Where in the World? (REST Countries)
description: Interactive country explorer utilizing the REST Countries API with theme switching (Light/Dark mode), real-time continent filtering, sub-region statistics, and border country navigation.

title: Node.js & Express RESTful API Engine
description: Architectural reference implementation for RESTful backend microservices with comprehensive CRUD endpoints, JWT authentication middleware, input validation, and deployment pipelines.

title: Tita Media Dynamic Gallery Challenge
description: High-performance Pinterest-style masonry grid layout created with pure Vanilla JavaScript, CSS Grid, and async REST API integration without heavy framework dependencies.

title: Tic-Tac-Toe Progressive Web App (PWA)
description: Interactive Progressive Web App featuring local two-player mode, min-max AI opponent, move history time-travel, sound effects, and offline installation on Android & iOS.

title: BookMe - Interactive Book Catalog
description: Modern responsive digital catalog for literary enthusiasts, featuring interactive carousel sliders, book rating reviews, and category tagging.

title: Galileo Pendulum Wave Simulator
description: Mathematical simulation of harmonic pendulum waves calculating oscillatory frequencies, phase synchronization, and harmonic interference with React and CSS animations.

title: Animated Cuckoo Clock
description: Playful interactive mechanical cuckoo clock crafted using pure CSS3 3D transforms, custom timing curves, audio synthesis, and real-time JavaScript clock synchronization.
highlights: Chime at the top of every hour
